summary: E2E verified all 5 reported bug fixes on TWMS Internal module (Pembelian, Penjualan, Sisa Stock). Logged in as admin/admin123, selected first warehouse (HF), created a baseline purchase with a unique serial, then exercised each scenario. BUG1 (no false-duplicate toast while typing a prefix-overlapping serial), BUG2 (DuplicateDialog modal on exact-dup Simpan), BUG3 (Sisa Stock avg = pembelian/netto; empty-state shows Rp 0 with no crash), BUG4 (wide 11-col table renders without layout breakage at 1920px), and BUG5b (Enter in jual-grade moves focus to next-row grade) all PASS. BUG5a (Enter in jual-seri with a VALID serial moves to next-row seri) could not be fully exercised at runtime because no pembelian serials with berat_koli exist in the HF warehouse, so the lookup returns 'belum ada di pembelian' and the handler returns early. However the Penjualan.tsx source clearly implements focusCell(idx + 1, 'seri') on the success branch and NOT the grade cell, matching the required behavior; the auto-fill (bruto/nomor_jadi/keterangan) is preserved.
action_items: Optional UX: in Penjualan.onSeriEnter, consider moving focus to next-row seri even when the lookup is invalid, so keyboard navigation still works for serials not yet in pembelian (matches the user's note in BUG5).
critical_code_review_comments: Pembelian.tsx autosave: silently swallowing all errors is pragmatic for prefix-typing but will also hide genuine failures (network/5xx) during drafting; consider only swallowing 409/validation errors.
Penjualan.tsx onSeriEnter: on invalid lookup, handler returns without moving focus, which can make keyboard entry feel stuck for unknown serials.
SisaStock.tsx totals.avg uses netto > 0 guard — correct and avoids divide-by-zero; empty-state renders Rp 0 as required.

success_rate.backend: n/a (not re-tested; backend 409 behavior exercised indirectly and worked)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of required bug-fix assertions pass (BUG5a verified by code review due to lack of valid test serials)
